Master bedroom me 10x8 sliding wardrobe with natural smoked walnut veneer and Italian PU polish. Master bathroom me 72 hours pond test ke sath Dr. Fixit waterproofing chahiye. Budget range 24-27 Lakhs.

Hardware and drawer systems carry manufacturer direct warranty (Hafele: 5-year mechanical warranty).
